videos.title: Why Did the "Unsinkable" Titanic Sink? 🚢🧊
videos.description:
The Titanic could float with 4 flooded compartments. The iceberg flooded 6, and the walls between them didn't reach the top, so the water spilled from one to the next like an ice cube tray. Only 20 lifeboats, 2 hours 40 minutes, about 1,500 lives.
What would have saved the Titanic? 👇

videos.title: How Was the Burj Khalifa Built? (On Sand!) 🏗️
videos.description:
828 meters standing on sand: 192 piles held up by friction, concrete poured at night with ice and pumped 600 m up, a new floor every 3 days, and a spire pushed up from inside.
Would you live on the top floor? 👇
